text: The substrate aligns agents by making dishonest or low-quality participation expensive at the point where quality becomes institutionally cognizable: validation.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Paper 2 - Architecture of the Agentic Reputation Substrate (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7260278

isBasedOn.name: Paper 2 - Architecture of the Agentic Reputation Substrate

abstract: The substrate does not attempt to align agents by constraining their internals, filtering their outputs, or supervising their reasoning. It aligns them by making dishonest or low-quality participation expensive at the point where quality becomes institutionally cognizable: validation.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: quality becomes institutionally cognizable through validation
